title: It's not strictly profit and a multiple
header_line: Jose's analysis of a book we are still naming. Not a summary of the book. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the author or publisher.

lines.text: When you buy or sell a business, who does the work, and what is it worth?

groups.heading: They raise capital, and they structure the deal

lines.text: What do investment bankers do, Jose asked? A student said: they raise capital. Jose said: very good. And they structure the deal, because it is complicated. They get the lawyers and the contracts. They have to overturn every single rock.

Another thing investment banks do, he said, is value the company. They come up with a number. People say valuations are strictly profit and a multiple. That is not true. I've seen transactions where the branding of a company was relevant. The image it has. The projections it has. The management it has.

Jose explained a hostile takeover. Imagine a company with shareholders. Somebody wants to buy it, goes behind the president's back, and starts buying voting stock. All of a sudden the president realizes the buyer owns a majority. The buyer can go to a shareholders meeting and fire the board, including the president, and take over the company.
There is voting stock and non-voting stock, he said. You can own a small share of a company and still control the majority of the votes. That is where you have to be very careful.
Jose read a line from the author about what he saw in this fight.
I realized just how powerful these networks were and the way they feared the strengths of the news division.

We start to learn the power of the media, Jose said. A bank backer left the deal because he was afraid of an investigative show. They could expose the hostile takeover, and he would be made out to be the bad guy and could lose a lot of business.
Who values what you own, and what do they see?

exercise.title: Five minutes
steps: Write who values your business or project from the outside.
Write what in your brand, image, projections and management adds value.
Write what share of your company's votes you keep if you take on partners.
Write what an outside investigator would find if they looked.
Write one thing that would raise your valuation that is not profit.

check.q: What did Jose say investment bankers do besides raise capital?
choices: Structure the deal and value the company

check.q: What did Jose say valuations are not strictly?
What did Jose say a hostile takeover can do to a president who loses the votes?
choices: The buyer can fire the board and take over

recap: Know who values your company, and keep control of the votes.
